title: Stripe Webhook signing secret: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: WHSEC_ vs the documented lowercase whsec_ (case of the documented prefix changed; Stripe's own scrubber and every cited rule are case-sensitive) and prefix: whsec- with a dash separator vs the documented whsec_ (separator of the documented prefix changed; body unchanged). Twin of "Stripe Webhook signing secret: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of stripe-webhook-signing-secret-export-webhook-secret: prefix: WHSEC_ vs the documented lowercase whsec_ (case of the documented prefix changed; Stripe's own scrubber and every cited rule are case-sensitive). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
